svg.title: RevCT — typed decisions from chest CT

cc:Work.dc:title: RevCT — typed decisions from chest CT
cc:Work.dc:description: RevCT processing: HU-valued chest CT NIfTI with physical geometry; 2 mm isotropic resampling and centred 192-cubed crop; frozen COLIPRI encoder and 18 trained heads; 18 present/absent decisions and calibrated scores. Approximately 147M parameters, 589 MB checkpoint. No language decoder. Research model v0.3.2.
